pages.text: Implemented classes are Pyromancer, Cryomancer, Stormcaller, Abysswalker, Earthshaper, Chronoweaver, and the hidden Omniscient class. A class can normally be selected only once. Shipped class talent trees mirror these seven class IDs and are loaded from server data.

Every node costs 1 talent point and may require lower-tier parent nodes. The universal tree has 30 nodes and a selected-class tree has 13, so both complete for 43 of the natural 52 points. Gates use cultivation realm rank: tiers 0-1 require rank 1, tier 2 rank 3, tier 3 rank 5, tier 4 rank 8, and tier 5 rank 11. Only one tier-5 node in a tree may be owned. A talent-tree node must belong to your selected class.

Every unlock request is checked on the server: node existence, already-unlocked state, realm-rank gate, matching class tree, all parents, sufficient points, and tier-5 exclusivity. Points are deducted only after validation.$(br2)$(bold)Warning:$() Client display is not permission. Rejected clicks do not grant a node.

JSON node values are applied directly without a hidden multiplier. Only nodes currently owned by the universal tree or your selected class contribute stats and passives. Reloaded orphan IDs and nodes moved to another class remain recorded but are ignored and receive no automatic refund. A full respec refunds only currently authorized nodes, clears all recorded nodes and the element pact, and restores the class's canonical mastery.

$(bold)Shared passive pools$()$(br)Dodge = min(15%, dodge stat + sum of Dodge chances), one roll. Passive damage reduction = min(30%, sum of passive reductions), applied once. Free cast = min(20%, sum of chances), one roll. Eligible execute effects do not multiply each other; only the largest current bonus applies.

$(bold)XP, survival, and healing$()$(br)Kill XP multiplier = min(2.5, 1 + XP stat bonus + sum(passive multiplier - 1)). Undying rolls once using the highest chance and, conservatively, the longest cooldown among active effects. Generic lifesteal plus elemental spell vamp heals from final post-mitigation damage and is capped at 10%. Configured spell-effect lifesteal remains separate.
